flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi workflows/furnish/stafffurnish/{controllers/StaffFurnishController.batchUpdateAddress, services/StaffFurnishService.batchUpdateAddress|staffUpdateOffenderAndAddress|createOrUpdateFurnishedMailAddress}; ocmsadminui pages/BatchUpdateODH. No code to reject a notice from a court application batch, a reject reason, or include/exclude from a batch.
note: URA status: Demo paid (50% of 75%), demo_remark: Vault Code Split (Vault permission for the api App Service server; cannot verify from repo). The story asks the OIC to amend and confirm the address, or reject the notice from the court application batch with a reason, and OCMS then decides include/exclude. Only the address amendment exists, through the generic Batch Update of Mailing Address screen (POST staff-furnish/batch-update-address): the furnished_mail mailing address is updated for many notices with the same offender ID, the stage is not changed. That is not a decision on a court application batch, so Sebagian. Reject with reason and include/exclude from a batch have no code (no batch, no decision status). No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim in full. Only address amendment through the generic screen exists; reject with reason and the include/exclude batch decision have no code. Ask URA/team in which repo the court application batch is built

steps.step: The OIC amends the address fields (postal code, block, street, floor/unit, building) on the notice
steps.detail: The generic Batch Update of Mailing Address screen provides the mailing address edit form (MailingAddressForm.tsx:65-133) on the batch-update-odh route (App.tsx:242-243). Staff open it through an ID search, not from a court application batch work item (OCMS22.11/22.12 have no code).

steps.step: The OIC confirms the address and the system saves it as the letter address
steps.detail: POST staff-furnish/batch-update-address calls batchUpdateAddress (StaffFurnishService.java:681-715); per notice staffUpdateOffenderAndAddress saves the furnished_mail address (createOrUpdateFurnishedMailAddress :945-996) and only marks it letter_address='Y' when the OIC ticks setAsLetterAddress (:600-601, :994-996). The notice stage is not changed. There is no 'confirmed' status for a court batch. The endpoint is listed in api-authorization.properties:90.

steps.step: The OIC can reject the notice from the court application batch
steps.detail: There is no action to reject a notice from a court application batch in the UI or the API; there is no court application batch (OcmsOffenceNoticeDetail.java:66-68 batch_no is commented out). grep with no result in the six repos for court_app / courtapp / court application / shortlist / court_batch / csd_batch / ocms_work_item (other than DataHive placeholder comments and UI labels).

steps.step: The reason for the rejection is recorded
steps.detail: There is no field or table for a court batch rejection reason. OcmsCourtCase.reason (OcmsCourtCase.java:30-31) is used by the PLUS/CAS court payment integration (CasIntegrationServiceImpl.java:637-666), not batch rejection.

steps.step: OCMS decides to include or exclude the notice in the batch based on the OIC's decision
steps.detail: No OIC decision is read to decide batch membership: batch_no is not used (OcmsOffenceNoticeDetail.java:66-68) and staffUpdateOffenderAndAddress returns the old stage unchanged (StaffFurnishService.java:611).
